description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget and associated UI components for the Con Living mobile app, implementing the main dashboard screen with header, hero card, featured tiles, poster carousel, and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main dashboard/home screen of the app.

classes.name: _HomeHeader
classes.description: Stateless widget for displaying the welcome text, app name, and notification/search icons.

classes.name: _HeaderIconButton
classes.description: Reusable icon button with outline for header actions.

classes.name: _HeroCard
classes.description: Displays the main featured card with gradient background, decorative X, and CTA button.

classes.name: _HeroTextBlock
classes.description: Contains the text elements and CTA button within the hero card.

classes.name: _DecorativeX
classes.description: Graphical 'X' decoration made with stacked rotated bars and gradient glow.

classes.name: _XBar
classes.description: Component representing one of the diagonal bars for decorative X.

classes.name: _QuickActionTileData
classes.description: Model for the quick action tiles, including icon and label.

classes.name: _FeaturedTilesRow
classes.description: Row or wrap of quick action tiles, responsive layout based on width.

classes.name: _QuickActionTile
classes.description: Individual quick action tile with icon and label.

classes.name: _PosterData
classes.description: Model describing poster card gradient backgrounds and overlay option.

classes.name: _CuratedCarousel
classes.description: Horizontal list of poster cards with spacing.

classes.name: _PosterCard
classes.description: Visual representation of each poster with gradient background and optional close overlay.

classes.name: _OverlayCloseFab
classes.description: Floating action button for closing overlays on posters.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Custom bottom navigation with icon-only buttons, managing selected state.

classes.name: _NavIconButton
classes.description: Icon button used within bottom navigation, showing selected state via color.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeScreen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for HomeScreen and subcomponents.

methods.name: onTap
methods.description: Callback for various tap interactions, for example close overlay or navigation.
